title: Anthropic's Cheaper Model Is Half the Price of Its Flagship
description:
Opus 5 costs 5 dollars in and 25 out per million tokens. Fable 5 costs 10 and 50. Exactly half, and it's the same price the old Opus 4.8 was, so the upgrade is free.

These are Anthropic's own numbers, straight off the announcement pages.

Full breakdown in the video linked below.

#shorts #claudeopus5 #anthropic
